title: openai-chat-completions-parity: streaming stability, roles/stop/logprobs, formatting & function-calls
author: Asha Patel
description:
Motivation: Close outstanding gaps in our OpenAI /v1/chat.completions compatibility layer so customers can switch with minimal transformers-side changes. This PR focuses on parity for: roles mapping, stop token semantics, logprobs passthrough, streaming stability (backpressure and chunk framing), response formatting (structured output consistency), and function/tool-calling semantics.

What changed (summary): - Implemented explicit role normalization and validation to accept both 'system/user/assistant' and legacy variants; added stricter error messages for malformed role arrays. - Stop handling: support multiple stop strings, prefix/suffix behavior matching OpenAI, and early termination hooks for streaming path. - Logprobs: propagate top_logprobs/top_logprobs_candidates in compatibility response and wire through existing token-level metadata, with limits and safe-guards to avoid large payloads. - Streaming stability: fixed race in stream_manager backpressure path, added chunk-framing to avoid partial JSON messages, and retry/backoff for transient gRPC/transport hiccups. - Function calls: unified schema for function definitions, improved resolver hooks, and deterministic selection of function vs. text response to match OpenAI heuristics. - Formatting: canonicalized chat response shape for both sync and streaming modes; added deterministic whitespace/trailing-newline handling to avoid downstream diffs. - Tests & docs: added unit, integration, and e2e tests covering cross-product of roles/stop/logprobs/streaming/function-calls and updated openai_compat docs and SDK shims.

Testing and rollout: - CI initially surfaced a flaky streaming test (stream_manager backpressure); fixed by introducing a small sleep and a deterministic drain order in the stream loop. - Added new e2e test that replays production-ish traces from perf-canary to validate chunk framing. - Feature gated the new function-call heuristics behind a compatibility flag for conservative rollout; default enabled for new customers and enabled by rollout for existing users. - Monitored on staging for 72h with no regressions.

Checklist: - [x] Role mapping implemented and covered by tests - [x] Stop sequence parity (multi-stop) - [x] Logprobs passthrough with payload caps - [x] Streaming framing + backpressure fixes - [x] Function-call schema + resolver hooks - [x] SDK shim updates (Python/TS) - [x] Docs updated (openai_compat.md) - [x] Performance sanity checks run (no >5% token latency regression)

Notes: This is a user-visible compatibility change; no breaking API changes. There is a small size increase when logprobs are requested (documented and capped). See release_notes for user-facing summary.
commits: feat(openai-compat): add role normalization and validation
fix(streaming): deterministic chunk framing and backpressure drain
feat(fncall): unify function definition mapping and resolver hooks
perf(formatters): canonicalize response formatting for parity
test(e2e): add parity tests for roles/stop/logprobs/streaming
docs(openai_compat): update examples and edge cases
chore(sdk): shim updates for python and typescript
comments: Miguel Herrera (reviewer): Looks good overall. Two requests: 1) can you add a short e2e that exercises multi-stop + streaming so we don't regress, and 2) confirm logprobs size cap behavior (safety).
Asha Patel (author): Added tests in tests/e2e/test_openai_chat_parity.py that replay perf trace; logprobs capped to 256 tokens / top_k=5 by default and documented in docs/openai_compat.md.
Liam O'Connor (reviewer): The streaming fix addresses the flake I saw in staging. One nit: please add a comment explaining the non-obvious sleep in stream_manager drain loop (race avoidance).
Asha Patel (author): Comment added and replaced ad-hoc sleep with a deterministic drain order; removed sleep in latest patch.
Sofia Zhang (approver): Verified parity tests locally and reviewed SDK shims. Approving — please squash-merge and include release note blurb.
CI Bot: Pipeline openai_compat.yml initially failed unit tests due to ordering in test_stop_sequences; rerun succeeded after fix. All checks passed.
release_notes: OpenAI /v1/chat.completions parity improvements: roles normalization, multi-stop semantics, logprobs passthrough (capped), streaming stability and chunk framing, and improved function-calling compatibility. No breaking changes. SDK shims for Python and TypeScript updated. See docs/openai_compat.md for migration notes and detailed behavior.
notes: Monitored rollout on staging for 72h; no regressions observed. Watch for increased payload sizes when requesting logprobs.
